The '''roali''' was a [[Willow (tree)/Legends|willow]]-like [[Tree/Legends|tree]] found on [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]],<ref name="GCG" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of rolling hills and [[Forest/Legends|forests]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Semagi sector/Legends|Semagi sector]]. Members of Cerea's [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="FDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> eventually came to use the tree's name as a [[Gender/Legends|female]] given name.<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The roali was mentioned in [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]]'s [[2003]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''.<ref name="GCG" />
